Pangolin CR 1/4

This long-bodied creature is covered in scales on its upper body that resemble a pine cone.

XP 200
N Tiny animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +2 size)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +1
Defensive Abilities protective ball

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee claw -1 (1d3-3)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks musk

STATISTICS

Str 4, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Attack +0; CMB +0; CMD 7 (11 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +8

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a pangolin familiar gains a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

Musk (Ex)

Up to twice per day, a pangolin can spray a stream of noxious musk at a single target within 10 feet as a standard action. With a successful ranged touch attack, the creature struck by this spray must make a DC 12 Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds and then sickened for 1d4 minutes by the horrific stench. A successful save reduces the effect to only 1d4 rounds of being sickened. A creature cannot use the scent ability as long as it is affected by this musk. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Protective Ball (Ex)

A pangolin can roll up into a ball as a swift action, increasing its natural armor bonus to +3 but decreasing its speed to 0 feet. Unrolling is a move action.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm plains
Organization solitary or mating pair
Treasure none

These small mammals look like thin badgers or skunks with armored scales on the upper parts of their bodies like scale mail. They have sharp claws that are used for digging for insects, but can be used for defense in a pinch. Most of the time, however, they hide a ball like an armadillo and/or spray musk akin to a skunk’s.
